title: christella evoluta
intro: Christella evoluta, commonly known as the Chinese tassel fern, is a species of fern in the family Thelypteridaceae. It is widely used in traditional Chinese medicine due to its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Christella evoluta include wound healing, immune system modulation, and protection against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of Christella evoluta include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and polysaccharides, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
